oncall-bot: ALERT: continuous-batching service 'rb-runtime' high p99 latency (>2.5s), queue depth spike, KV cache eviction rate exploding. Incident id INC-20260714-7321. Paging: @alex @maria @sre-jamie
alex: I see it, grabbing metrics now
alex: p99 jump at ~1767009940. errors 502 -> 3% over 5m. KV evictions 10/s -> ~420/s. microbatch size avg fell 16 -> 3 under pressure
maria: which region & model? any customer impact?
alex: us-west-2; model redwood-open-7b-instruct; route /v1/generate. CS reported increased latency for chat flows (Sam)
customer-success-sam: we have two customers on dedicated capacity opening tickets, both in us-west-2. forwarding request ids and sample traces to ops
eng-runtime-lee: digging into logs — seeing a lot of "kv_cache: evict key=... reason=frag-resync" and repeated prefix resyncs. microbatches are being emitted as size=1 frequently. suspect resync window widened after last controller rollout
eng-runtime-lee: logs snippet:
```
[1767009942] rb-runtime instance-3: kv_cache: evict key=conv-abc123 reason=prefix-mismatch shard=7
[1767009943] rb-runtime instance-3: batch_emit size=1 jitter=0.18 controller.resync_ms=420
[1767009945] rb-runtime instance-3: queue_depth=612 inflight=920
```
eng-runtime-lee: looks like controller.resync_ms jumped to ~420ms causing many tiny microbatches and KV churn
sre-jamie: mitigation ideas: throttle new in-flight sessions to stabilize batch sizes; temporarily narrow resync window and increase jitter smoothing; also consider triggering a KV compaction sweep to reduce fragmentation
alex: I can apply a canary config: reduce controller.max_inflight from 800 -> 600, set batching.jitter=0.12, and controller.resync_ms -> 180
maria: canary first in us-west-2a only pls
alex: issuing canary now:
`/ops/configs apply rb-runtime --env us-west-2a --set controller.max_inflight=600 --set batching.jitter=0.12 --set controller.resync_ms=180`
oncall-bot: CANARY: config applied to rb-runtime/us-west-2a instance-3 at 1767010105
alex: canary metrics: p99 down to 1.2s, evictions down to ~18/s, avg microbatch size back to ~12
eng-runtime-lee: good. schedule KV cache compaction sweep on canary node to reclaim fragmentation (sweep id sweep-20260714-1)
sre-jamie: if canary stable for 5m we roll remainder. Also add temporary controller throttle to reject new sessions above low-priority threshold to prevent queue pileup
alex: starting rolling config now to remaining us-west-2 nodes
oncall-bot: ROLLING: config rollout started for rb-runtime/us-west-2 at 1767010250
alex: mid-roll metrics show p99 improving cluster-wide. applying cache compaction as we go. adding temporary fallback: if queue_depth>500 route to model-quantized-variant
eng-runtime-lee: applied fallback rule: routing.policy.queue_threshold=500 -> model: redwood-open-7b-q4_0
customer-success-sam: sent customer update: "Investigating elevated latencies in us-west-2; rolling config patch and cache sweep in progress. Expect intermittent 100-200ms hiccups. We'll update in 10 minutes."
maria: handing off overnight watch to @sre-jamie. I'll open follow-up ticket to investigate root cause of controller rollout expanding resync window and why resync_ms drifted
sre-jamie: taking over. handoff notes: canary applied and stable; roll completed at 1767010600; cache sweep scheduled every 5m for 30m; temporary throttle and fallback rules in place; follow-up ticket INFR-4129 created. traces collected: trace-ids = ["tr-1767009942-1","tr-1767009970-4","tr-1767010022-2"]
alex: arch note: PR to add a guard so controller rollout cannot expand resync window >200ms queued (#PR-ops-guard). filing now
maria: status update: mitigating -> monitoring. customer impact limited to dedicated customers in us-west-2 (latency only). no data loss.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated; owner=@sre-jamie; incident id INC-20260714-7321
sre-jamie: overnight plan: watch for replays of prefix-resyncs, run local high-concurrency simulator with resync jitter patterns, repro patch if needed, follow up with infra for controller rollout audit. we'll draft postmortem tomorrow
alex: :heavy_check_mark: nice work. closing pager for now — keep monitoring and escalate if anything flares
maria: /cc @eng-runtime-lee — follow-up ticket should include controller rollout timeline, config diffs, and a binary search of the resync param changes
sre-jamie: will do. leaving detailed handoff in INFR-4129. 1767011300: handoff complete.
